citationSources.notes: Custom $150–200/hr; flat rates for small/flash based on size/complexity.
Small 2x2 $50–250; Medium portrait $150–450; Large sleeves start $500 up to $4000 full back; Toronto hourly $175–190/hr; $100 minimum.
Half sleeve 10–18 hours; small tattoos per-piece pricing; large priced by hour ($80–$500/h range).
Hourly $175–190 typical; $100 min for small pieces.
Color portraits add 20–30% time/cost over black & grey; full-color up to $1200+ vs black & grey $300–600.
Full sleeve color $4k–$10k+ vs black & grey $3k–$7k; color requires more layering/blending time.
Color not always premium but multi-layer vibrant work adds 15–35% time depending on palette complexity.
